base.motivation: After observing the equal-prior blend's negative 360M transfer result, evaluate an analytically baseline-protected prior without changing the original confirmation.
base.prior_choice: 95% mass on pure neural, remaining 5% uniform over 20 other fixed mixture weights; chosen for -log(.95) comparator ceiling, not fitted to document losses
base.selection_policy: Every completed model and every document in the frozen confirmation; no model, document, mixture weight or prior tuning
base.uncertainty: posthoc descriptive paired document-cluster bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed 90211; not a new held-out validation
